The operational processes described in the text reveal two primary bottlenecks that hinder efficiency in the HomeTech customer service department. First, the lack of integration between software systems forces representatives to perform repeated data entry and switch between multiple platforms, which causes significant delays. Second, the absence of a centralized knowledge base results in inconsistent information being provided to customers.

To improve efficiency, the following changes are recommended:
1. Integrate the existing software systems to eliminate redundant data entry and allow seamless navigation between platforms.
2. Implement a centralized knowledge base to ensure all representatives have access to consistent, accurate information.
